# Remote-work equipment policy

Eligible full-time employees may work remotely up to three days each week with
manager approval. The company reimburses approved home-office equipment up to
five hundred dollars each calendar year. Submit an itemized receipt through the
finance portal within thirty days of purchase. Reimbursements cover ergonomic
chairs, monitor arms, and standing desks used for productive remote work.

The remote-work policy requires employees to remain available during core
collaboration hours. Department managers record approved schedules before each
quarter. Requests above the standard remote-work allocation require written
approval from the vice president of human resources.
